scenarios.baseline: the model commits and opens a PR from memory of the ticket without composing commit-message.md/pr-body.md or running the ship checks
expected_behavior: runs ai-flow stage start PROJ-200 ship
runs ai-flow standards check PROJ-200 --stage ship
